data.decision: Return PJAN-119: new boards still bypass schema application and warning
data.reasoning: Independent review and direct source inspection confirm schema checks precede deferred board creation and skip an unlinked board; creation adds no subsequent schema step or defaults warning. Existing schema and ingress tests pass separately but do not verify this boundary. Prefer fixing the shared creation seam or explicit fallback over accepting an unsupported handback. Apply current Krebs five-lane policy, not historical nine-lane wording.
